when: Data has a time axis; the reader asks how it is developing; rate of change matters over a continuous period
when_not: Fewer than 4 points (use KPI card with micro-context); more than ~4-6 series (small multiples instead); no time dimension
pbi_native: Line chart; small multiples for >4 series
notes: No smoothed lines that invent data (visual-selection.md); axis periods explicit

when: Comparing or ranking discrete categories; category names need to read horizontally; <=15 categories
when_not: Categories >15 (table with data bars + search); a time dimension (line); proportions (100% stacked)
pbi_native: Clustered bar chart, sorted descending, value labels on
notes: Bars start at zero, always (trust rules)

when: Few discrete periods (months, quarters) where each period is read individually
when_not: Many periods (line); category comparison (horizontal bar reads better)

when: Few parts of a whole compared across categories or periods; the mix is the message
when_not: Parts >5 (treemap); precise per-part values needed (table); one snapshot with 2-3 parts only (consider donut, reluctantly)
deneb: Waffle spec when a single filled-fraction reads better
notes: Pie/donut beyond 2-3 slices and exploded pies are Avoid-column material (visual-selection.md)

when: One share-of-whole number that must be felt, not just read (e.g. 73% coverage) as the page's focal moment
when_not: More than ~3 categories; exact values matter more than proportion; tight grid slots
deneb: Yes - 10x10 grid spec, brand tokens in config
notes: Deneb justification: native serves magnitude but not felt proportion

when: Many parts of a whole with size relationships; shallow hierarchy (<=2 levels) overview
when_not: Sibling values need precise comparison (sorted bar); depth >2-3 levels; negative values
notes: Sunbursts: refuse; re-route to treemap

when: Relationship between two continuous measures; spotting clusters/outliers across entities
when_not: Categorical variables (grouped bar); fewer than ~20 points (pattern not meaningful)
deneb: Hexbin/density spec when thousands of points overplot
notes: Bubble size as 3rd variable sparingly; no dual-axis causation theater

when: Intensity across a 2D grid (e.g. activity by weekday x hour); pattern over precision
when_not: Fewer than ~20 cells (bar); exact values needed (matrix with numbers, no color); color as only carrier
pbi_native: Matrix + conditional formatting (background color scale) with values visible
notes: Pair color with the printed value - color never the only carrier (hard rule 3)

when: Regional dimension where spatial distribution is itself the insight
when_not: Region size distorts comparison (sorted bar instead); geography is just a category
pbi_native: Azure Maps visual; Shape map for custom regions
deneb: — (route native; topojson specs rarely earn the cost)
notes: Decorative maps that carry no data: refuse (hard rule 6)

when: Sequential stages with monotonically decreasing values; conversion/drop-off is the question
when_not: Stages not sequential; values not monotonic (bar); fewer than 3 stages

when: Positive/negative components adding to a total (P&L walk, budget variance)
when_not: Changes not additive; more than ~12 bars (group into Other); reader expects a simple total
deneb: Custom bridge spec if native breakdown limits bite
notes: First choice for what drove the change (visual-selection.md intent 8)

when: Interactive decomposition of a metric into contributing factors; exploration pages
when_not: Reader expects a summary, not exploration; no parent-child causal structure
notes: Native serves this fully; no Deneb case

when: Quantities flowing between nodes, multi-source to multi-target
when_not: Flows form loops; <3 source-target pairs; a waterfall or decomposition tree answers the question
notes: Escalate to cv-custom-visual with written justification, or re-route to waterfall/decomposition tree

keywords: kpi, hero number, headline metric, target
when: One headline number with micro-context (delta, target, period); the page's focal moment
when_not: Many KPIs side by side (bullet grid or table); trend is the real question (line)
pbi_native: Card (new) with reference labels; KPI visual
deneb: Bullet spec when target + qualitative ranges must show
notes: Gauge is context-poor - Avoid column (visual-selection.md intent 1)

keywords: bullet, target, benchmark, compact KPI grid
when: 3-10 KPIs against targets side by side; space-constrained performance overview
when_not: Single KPI with emphasis (KPI card); no defined target
pbi_native: — (approximate: table with data bars + target line)
deneb: Yes - classic Deneb case: measure bar, target tick, qualitative ranges from tokens
notes: Never two fat bars per category for actual-vs-target (visual-selection.md intent 9)

keywords: deviation, vs plan, vs prior year, diverging
when: How far off plan/prior per category, from a zero/target baseline, good/bad pair encoding
when_not: No baseline exists; direction encoding would be color-only (pair with sign/arrow, hard rule 3)
pbi_native: Bar chart from zero baseline + conditional formatting with the good/bad pair
deneb: Diverging spec with explicit baseline rule when native formatting falls short
notes: Baseline shown as a line, not a memory (trust rules)

when: History plus projection with honest uncertainty for planning discussions
when_not: No historical baseline; audience will read the band as certainty; confidence too low to be useful
deneb: Errorband spec when bounds are model-computed DAX columns
notes: Label the forecast start; scenario logic labeled (doctrine: honesty)

when: Time series where the outliers are the story; operational review pages
when_not: Anomalies are predefined categories (bar with highlight); real-time monitoring (not report territory)
pbi_native: Line chart + Analytics pane anomaly detection
deneb: Layered point+rule spec when anomaly logic lives in DAX
notes: Gray context, accent only on the anomalies

when: How a measure spreads; >=20 points; averages would hide the shape
when_not: Few points; reader needs individual records (table)
pbi_native: Clustered column over a binned axis (grouping/bins on the field)
deneb: Binned bar spec when native binning is too coarse
notes: Averages hiding the spread is the Avoid (visual-selection.md intent 6)

when: Comparing spread/median/outliers across groups; statistically literate audience
when_not: <20 points per group; audience unfamiliar (histogram or strip plot instead)
deneb: Yes - Vega-Lite boxplot mark, tokens in config
notes: Standard Deneb justification: no native form serves the intent

when: Small groups where individual values deserve to stay visible; compact comparison
when_not: Many points per group (box plot or histogram)
pbi_native: Scatter chart with jittered category axis (workaround)
deneb: Yes - cleaner as a spec; tick/point marks
notes: Also valid for comparison (visual-selection.md intent 3)

when: The reader wants the records; restrained styling, data bars/sparklines only where they aid scanning
when_not: The page's message needs a shape, not rows; endless scroll without a search intent
pbi_native: Table or Matrix: right-aligned numbers, one decimal discipline, no zebra noise
notes: Sparklines in tables serve scanning, never decoration (report-craft-floor.md)

when: Almost never - only when 2-3 entities across 5-8 fixed attributes and the audience already reads radar
when_not: Precise comparison needed (grouped bar); >8 axes; general business audiences
notes: Avoid-column material (visual-selection.md intent 3); re-route to sorted bars or small multiples

when: Financial OHLC data for a finance-literate audience; price-range story per period
when_not: Non-financial audience; no OHLC data (line chart); accessibility-first context
deneb: Yes - layered rule+bar spec, good/bad pair from tokens
notes: Deneb justification on record per dn-deneb gate

when: Entity-to-entity connection topology is genuinely the question
when_not: Node count beyond a few dozen; precise counts needed (matrix/table); report canvas at all, usually
notes: Escalate to cv-custom-visual with justification; usually re-route to matrix or table

when: Effectively never on a report page - word size is imprecise by design
when_not: Any context where values matter; screen-reader users; executive pages
notes: Fails 3-minute trust; re-route to sorted bar of term frequencies

when: Never - hard rule 6 forbids 3-D charts
when_not: Always on report pages
notes: Refuse; find the 2D projection that answers the question

when: Not a report-page form - live monitoring belongs to dashboards/streaming datasets, outside the s0-s7 lifecycle
when_not: Report pages refresh on schedule; flashing content fails accessibility
notes: Note the requirement in the design contract and route it out of scope
